# Ingress Tool Transfer - PowerShell Download Cradle (Composite L2.5)

**Tactic:** Command and Control (TA0011) · **ATT&CK:** [T1105](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1105/) · [T1059.001](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1059/001/)  
**Status:** ⏳ Awaiting first run  
**Data:** `DeviceProcessEvents`, `DeviceFileEvents` · **Platforms:** Microsoft Defender XDR Advanced Hunting, Microsoft Sentinel (MDE connector) · **Production lookback:** 7d  
**Rule:** [`PowerShell_Download_Ingress_Cradle_V2.kql`](PowerShell_Download_Ingress_Cradle_V2.kql) · **Author:** Ala Dabat

## Minimum truth

> PowerShell runs with download intent and an external URL in its command line.

## Reinforcement

Execution intent (IEX), long -enc payload, suspicious parent, writable-path or executable file drop.

## Known coverage boundaries

Documented cases where this implementation of the technique does not produce the rule's minimum truth. They run on every build and will report when a rule change closes the gap.

- **`test.yml`**: coverage boundary - Empire's stager hides the download inside -enc base64 and its lab C2 is 10.10.10.5 (RFC1918), so the minimum truth (cleartext download intent + external URL) is never visible; needs -enc decoding
- **`test_empire_sct_regsvr32.yml`**: coverage boundary - same encoded stager launched via regsvr32/SCT; download intent hidden in -enc
